name: hub-interaction-frvcqp
goal: Answer confirmation survives refresh, project groups expose running first and due-state labels show the current work state.

evidence: Home answers lose their selected label on receipt or refresh. Live group summaries omit zero counts, and queued and inactive work appears on first expand. WIP and detail use a red past-due clock.

Needs-you scenarios assert dispatch only. Live overview scenarios check running rows without requiring the initial group filter. Past-due scenarios verify the unlisted queue but never inspect WIP badges. Strengthen all three existing paths.

At test-only commit 1803197e04, all six Chromium cases failed on harbor-mbp-2. The selected answer receipt, live project counts and current work labels were missing. Harness red checkpoint 8ea942c35993ef9db607f692dcd0f06f570d6c4eaedc59ee7793ec3cb09d4af1.
62c84f46b7 retains the selected answer through refresh, renders running jobs first, and replaces elapsed overdue labels with the current work state.

At 62c84f46b7 the same six desktop and phone Chromium cases passed on harbor-mbp-2 in 34.6 seconds with the same frozen tests, runner and assertion. Harness green checkpoint f8d4894215e48bdd207e12c08f15e79a27f4c0b1dfe4401e261e7bffd91d4b3b.
